name: Security Identification 26 Choice
definition: Specifies the identification of a financial instrument.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISIN). A numbering system designed by the United Nation's International Organisation for Standardisation (ISO). The ISIN is composed of a 2-character prefix representing the country of issue, followed by the national security number (if one exists), and a check digit. Each country has a national numbering agency that assigns ISIN numbers for securities in that country.

NotAvailable.name: Not Available
NotAvailable.definition: Default value, when not identification is available.
